name: Simulator: immediate cancel (S46) drops pending prorations; end_trial without a trial is rejected
description: R8 cancel_now and R4 end_trial: Stripe's immediate cancel never invoices pending prorations, and ending a trial on a subscription that is not trialing is refused with a reason.

planSteps.description: Open the app home page and choose 'S46' in the 'Load scenario' dropdown
Assert the '✅ Matches golden expected' badge is shown
Assert the timeline contains an event whose type is 'Cancel immediately'

Assert exactly 3 invoices are shown: Invoice 1 dated 2027-01-01 totals $79.00, Invoice 2 dated 2027-02-01 totals $29.00, Invoice 3 dated 2027-03-01 totals $29.00, and no invoice contains an 'Unused time' or 'Remaining time' line
Change the type of the 'Cancel immediately' event to 'End trial now'
Assert an error message containing 'end_trial needs a subscription in trial' is shown
